comment: Approved exceptions to the Flight Deck protected boundary (scripts/test/flight-deck-boundary.mjs). Read from the merge base, so an exception takes effect only after it is merged. Each needs the branch it applies to, the decision that authorizes it, and a reason. 'paths' permits protected paths; 'structural' permits structural differences in mixed files.

exceptions.reason: PR 4.1 (boundary and baseline): adds the checker, census and capture tooling, the E2E output override, the CI job that runs them, and the recorded baseline
R2: classify incomplete recovery and non-durable operator deactivation as failure notices using the existing alert branch; preserve all action and authorization behavior
